summary.text: Everett Stubbs is a Republican member of the South Carolina Senate for District 17, which covers Chester, Fairfield, Lancaster and York Counties.
He is an attorney and sits on the Senate Judiciary and Education committees.

paragraphs.text: Stubbs was born on June 17, 1985, in Greenville.
His official page lists a B.S. from Lander University in 2008 and a J.D. from Charlotte School of Law in 2011.
His committee assignments are Agriculture and Natural Resources, Education, Family and Veterans' Services, Fish, Game and Forestry, and Judiciary.
He married Caroline Rockholt on August 25, 2012, and they have two children.
